title: Drive ignores the speed command
summary: A running drive that ignores speed commands is usually set to another reference source.

sections.heading: Reference sources
sections.body: Drives can take their speed reference from terminals (analog or preset inputs), a fieldbus or the keypad. Only the selected source counts; commands on the other sources are ignored.

sections.heading: Check
sections.body: Read the reference source on the drive display and compare the speed with the commanded preset.

troubleshooting.effect: The drive runs at the wrong speed
symptoms: Speed does not follow the selector
Speed fixed at a keypad value
evidence: Display shows the keypad as source
troubleshooting.explanation: Configuration decides which command a drive obeys; wiring alone does not.
